STEP 6 - Grams: Cut cooked vegetables, bulk density ~0.6 g/ml. 126 ml x 0.6 ≈ 76 g.

STEP 7 - Energy: Cooked carrots ≈ 35 kcal per 100 g. 76 g x 0.35 ≈ 27 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: Eight to ten carrot pieces totaling about 75 g is plausible for a small side portion. A few tens of kcal fits raw-ish cooked carrot with no added fat visible. Estimate is modest and reasonable.

Total: about 76 g, about 27 kcal.
